data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG informs Mara Beispiel (Vertragskonto BE-3301 8812) that electricity prices will increase from 01.01.2026: the working price rises from 31.48 to 34.92 ct/kWh, the base price from €12.90 to €13.90/month, and the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) from €72.00 to €81.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity supplier is raising its prices as of 01.01.2026, increasing your monthly payment by €9. Because this is a price increase, German law (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG) gives you a special right to cancel the contract without the usual notice period, effective from the date the new price applies — the app will show the exact cancellation window separately. If you do nothing, the new, higher price and Abschlag simply apply automatically. Any cancellation must be in text form (e.g. letter or email). No other action is required unless you want to switch provider.
